root_cause.text: In `ath12k_mac_op_change_vif_links`, the error path for link removal skips cleanup of the `ahvif->links_map` entry for an `arvif` that was initialized but not yet created (`is_created` false), leaving a stale mapping that later triggers a `WARN_ON` when the same link ID is reused.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif)` inside the `if (!arvif->is_created)` branch, directly addressing the missing cleanup. The commit message states that when MLO preparation fails before `arvif->is_created` is set, the link deletion logic only executes for created arvifs, so the stale mapping persists until a new arvif uses the same link ID, causing the warning at `drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath12k/mac.c:4271`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing cleanup for uncreated link vifs by calling ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif before continuing to avoid state inconsistencies.
intent_record.what: Added a call to ath12k_mac_unassign_link_vif(arvif) before continue inside the if block that checks !arvif->is_created, and added braces around the block.
intent_record.how: Before skipping an uncreated link vif (arvif->is_created == false), the code now performs the unassign operation, which properly cleans up the link vif assignment and prevents resource leaks or inconsistent state.
